description: Commission a NEW analysis built for your question. tier is REQUIRED. The user picks. Easiest: fuzzy_request (plain language) + dataset_ref + tier. Snapshot = instant automated report (~2-10 min). JSON = a fast computed answer, numbers + method, re-runnable tool you own (~5 min). Brief = the computed answer on a one-page report: chart, numbers, method (~7 min). Deck = commissioned deep analysis, a durable re-runnable module you own (30-45 min). Failed builds are never billed.

fuzzy_request.description: Plain-language description of the analysis you want

notes.description: Optional context for the build, constraints, definitions, or preferences the analyst agents should honor

tier.description: snapshot = instant report (~2-10 min); json = fast computed answer (~5 min, default); brief = one-page report of the answer (~7 min); deck = commissioned re-runnable module (30-45 min)

name: create_analysis
